notes.title: Patch V2.02
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
Pressing escape from settings menu now closes menu as expected
Fixed issue with speed run time
Fixed volume settings defaulting to .5 instead of 1
Fixed bug with Entanglor Boss stuck at 0 hp

notes.title: V2.01 Major Update
notes.content:
New Art
New Content (Bosses, Upgrades, Levels)
Bug Fixes

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Quantum Contours got a major update. [/h1]

[h2]Art[/h2]
The art in the game got a complete overhaul. New bosses, new levels and new UI.

[h2]Gameplay and Mechanics[/h2]
Bugs were fixed, new upgrades were added, as well as all new enemies and bosses to fight.
